name: load-shared-300
description: 300 clients x 5 prompts sharing one HttpClient (one HTTP/2 connection)
comment: Baselines from the 2026-09-25 pre-release load run. Latency (p50/p99) is recorded, never asserted. Known, timing-dependent: when all 300 clients close at once, their stream cancellations (RST_STREAM) exceed Jetty's HTTP/2 rate control (WindowRateControl, 128 events/s by default) and the server sends GOAWAY for the shared connection. Every prompt and every close still succeeds (asserted); the client transport logs ERROR 'Transport error ... GOAWAY received' for the cut SSE streams, so 'ERROR ' is not forbidden here and the GOAWAY count is reported instead.

processes.name: clients
processes.run: java -Xmx1g -Dacp.client.level=INFO -cp target/classes:$(cat target/classpath.txt) load.LoadClients http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/acp 300 5 shared
